findings.finding: Both are Aeroplan economy awards at 65,000 points, but their reported schedules differ: J14 leaves Jan 15 at 23:15 and arrives Jan 17 at 09:50 (1,175 min); J8 leaves Jan 15 at 11:45 and arrives Jan 16 at 22:25 (1,180 min). J8 arrives on the prior local date despite taking 5 minutes longer.

These report matching SFO–LAX–IST–BKK schedules (Jan 15 06:18 departure; Jan 17 08:50 arrival; 2,132 min), with economy at 110,000 Turkish points versus business at 275,000. Both are conditional separate-ticket journeys; schedule matching does not establish identical physical flights or other booking facts, and the economy option means business is not needed to obtain this schedule.
